summary: Three inactive proofs reconstruct global weak modified comparison and strict bounded Hessian domination on arbitrary Hermitian backgrounds. The mixed maximum formula gives a signed weighted torsion error; a triangular mixed-degree induction and an eta-cubed diagonal absorption control it. No unmodified global comparison or extra bounded-product assumption is imported.
